calculate_dtw_distance_between_trajector: calculate the DTW distance between a test trajectory and a reference trajectory using normalized Euclidean pose distance
compute_dtw_scores: compute DTW scores comparing a test trajectory against a set of reference trajectories for each waypoint
is_pose_within_bounds: check if a test pose is within linear and angular bounds of a target pose
is_position_within_bounds: check if a test 3D position is within xy and z distance thresholds of a target position
wrap_angle_deg: wrap an angle in degrees between 0 and 360 or between -180 and 180
